description: Corporate directory, single sign-on, MFA, PAM, and identity governance for all 45,000 workforce users
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every division signs in through SYS-G1; OT servers at Plants 2 and 5 and DC automation servers also authenticate to the corporate domain, so a directory outage or compromise stops plants, DCs, and store back offices at once
source_evidence: EV-080 (Group identity director interview); EV-010 (OT and DC servers on the corporate domain; restore tested 2025)
manual_workaround: Sealed break-glass accounts per critical system; separate OT domain at Plants 1, 3, 4, and 6; store POS runs offline for card authorization fallback
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Used by every process below

business_process: Cloud landing zones, colocation data center, and WAN
description: Network hubs and guardrails in providers A and B, the colocation data center, and links to 6 plants, 5 DCs, and 120 stores
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cold-chain alerts, MES production orders, food safety records, POS authorization, and WMS all cross the WAN or the hubs
source_evidence: EV-080 (Group infrastructure director interview); EV-017 (links and cellular failover); EV-016 (cloud inventory)
manual_workaround: Cellular failover at every store and DC; plants keep local control without WAN
dependent_third_parties: Cloud providers A and B; carriers; colocation provider
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All divisions; the cold-chain alert integration server sits in the colocation data center

description: About 21,000 sensors in plant, DC, trailer, and store cold storage; alert routing to on-call roles through the alert integration server
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Food safety: loss of temperature monitoring for more than 2 hours forces product evaluation at every affected plant, DC, and store (9 CFR 417.3(b) for plant CCPs; 21 CFR 117.206(a)(3) for DC refrigerated packaged food); one integration server serves all three divisions
source_evidence: EV-080 (Group cold-chain services manager interview); EV-025 (21,000 sensors; one alert integration server; 24-hour gateway buffer); EV-026 (DR runbook)
manual_workaround: Hourly manual temperature logs at every site; gateways buffer readings locally for 24 hours; store managers check case thermometers
dependent_third_parties: Cold-chain monitoring SaaS vendor; SMS provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Site on-call roles in all divisions
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Meat Processing plant cold storage (BP-M01); DC storage (BP-D01); trailers (BP-D03); store cases (BP-R02)

description: 24x7 SOC, SIEM, EDR, and incident handling for IT and (at four plants and two DCs) OT
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Notification clocks (9 CFR 418.2, 21 U.S.C. 350f(d), state breach laws, Form 8-K Item 1.05) keep running during an outage; the SOC establishes the facts behind every notice
source_evidence: EV-080 (Group SOC director interview); EV-011 (SOC coverage)
manual_workaround: Forensic retainer tooling; EDR console reachable from provider B
dependent_third_parties: SIEM and EDR vendors; forensic retainer
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All divisions depend on the SOC for detection and incident facts

description: Compressors, evaporators, and ammonia detection at five plants above the PSM threshold
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Worker and community safety (ammonia release) and product temperature; controllers run locally but a tampered or failed controller needs manual operation under PSM procedures
source_evidence: EV-081 (plant refrigeration manager interviews); EV-053 (ammonia inventories)
manual_workaround: Manual operation by licensed refrigeration operators; hardwired ammonia alarms; emergency response plan
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Cold-chain monitoring (BP-G04) reports the temperatures; DC-1 and DC-3 freezers have equivalent systems

business_process: Plant cold storage temperature control and monitoring
description: Coolers, freezers, and shipping docks at six plants; cold storage CCP monitoring
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cold storage is a CCP in the HACCP plans; a monitoring gap of more than 2 hours requires FSQA evaluation of every lot in storage (9 CFR 417.3(b))
source_evidence: EV-081 (Division VP FSQA interview); EV-054 (cold storage CCPs); EV-025 (plant sensors)
manual_workaround: Hourly manual temperature logs; move product to shore-powered trailers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Depends on BP-G04 and BP-G03

business_process: DC refrigerated and frozen storage temperature control
description: Refrigerated and frozen rooms at five DCs, including 3PL customer product
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Refrigerated packaged food requires temperature monitoring, corrective action, and verification (21 CFR 117.206(a)); 3PL customers rely on temperature history
source_evidence: EV-082 (division food safety manager interview); EV-066 (room setpoints and monitoring)
manual_workaround: Hourly manual readings; door discipline; hold product on loss of control
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Depends on BP-G04; holds Meat Processing finished product for stores

business_process: Store refrigerated case and walk-in monitoring
description: Display cases and walk-in coolers and freezers at 120 stores
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customer safety and state and local food code temperature rules (handled generically); shrink
source_evidence: EV-083 (retail food safety director interview); EV-079 (case controllers on SYS-G6)
manual_workaround: Manual case checks every 2 hours; move product to walk-ins
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Depends on BP-G04; fresh and deli meat comes from Meat Processing via the DCs

description: 1,450 lanes and self-checkouts in 120 stores
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $16.5 million in sales per day; customers cannot buy food; PCI DSS requires the CDE to stay segmented during recovery
source_evidence: EV-083 (retail store operations VP interview); EV-003 (Grocery Retail revenue); EV-073 (1,450 lanes)
manual_workaround: Store-and-forward card authorization for a limited period; cash and offline tender
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Price and promotion files from BP-R04; WAN (BP-G03)

description: Smokehouses, ovens, and chill systems at six plants
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Undercooking or slow chilling can make product adulterated; CCP records must be complete before shipment (9 CFR 417.5(c))
source_evidence: EV-081 (plant operations manager interviews); EV-054 (thermal CCPs)
manual_workaround: Finish or abort cycles on local controllers; chart recorders; manual probe readings; hold product
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Domain authentication at Plants 2 and 5 (BP-G01)

description: About 900 refrigerated trailers delivering to stores and customers; reefer setpoints and temperature records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Sanitary transportation: adequate temperature control and records (21 CFR 1.908); a possible material temperature failure stops sale until a qualified individual decides (1.908(a)(6))
source_evidence: EV-082 (fleet director interview); EV-065 (900 trailers with telematics)
manual_workaround: Paper setpoint sheets; driver temperature checks at loading and delivery
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Stores (BP-R05) and 3PL customers (BP-D04) wait on deliveries

description: MES formulations and setpoints from the central recipe master library to dosing skids and smokehouses
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Formulations change rarely, so the last approved release is an acceptable recovery point; restored recipes must be verified against the signed master before use because a changed cure setpoint is what an attacker would leave behind
source_evidence: EV-081 (division controls engineering manager interview); EV-061 (signed releases and paper masters); EV-048 (recovery runbooks)
manual_workaround: Hand-weighed batches from signed formulation sheets
dependent_systems: SYS-M3; recipe master library on SYS-G3
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: ERP production orders (BP-G05); provider A hosting

business_process: Processing, packaging, lot coding, and labeling
description: Grinding, slicing, packaging, metal detection, checkweighing, lot codes, and labels
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $28 million revenue per production day across six plants; mislabeled or uncoded product is misbranded
source_evidence: EV-081 (plant operations manager interviews); EV-003 (Meat Processing revenue over about 250 production days)
manual_workaround: Pre-printed labels with manual lot codes and second-person check
dependent_third_parties: AI vision vendor; packaging equipment vendors
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: WMS lot and pallet data (BP-D02) for shipments to DCs

description: WMS-directed receiving, putaway, picking, and shipping at five DCs; automated freezer storage at DC-1 and DC-3
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Stores carry 1 to 3 days of perishables; independent grocers switch suppliers after missed deliveries
source_evidence: EV-082 (DC general manager interviews); EV-064 (WMS and DC automation)
manual_workaround: Paper pick lists from the last export; manual freezer retrieval
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: DC automation servers authenticate to the corporate domain (BP-G01); orders from ERP (BP-G05)

business_process: Group ERP: orders, production orders, and procurement
description: Order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, production orders to MES, and inventory for all divisions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Production orders and invoicing for all three divisions; intercompany flows
source_evidence: EV-080 (Group CIO interview); EV-030 (ERP scope and 1-hour RPO)
manual_workaround: Manual order capture; production from standing schedules
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Meat Processing MES, DC WMS, and store replenishment all depend on it

business_process: Food safety records and pre-shipment review
description: Electronic HACCP, Sanitation SOP, and food defense monitoring records; pre-shipment review
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Product cannot ship without pre-shipment review of complete records (9 CFR 417.5(c)); records must be available to FSIS (417.5(f))
source_evidence: EV-081 (Division VP FSQA interview); EV-047 (SYS-M5 configuration); EV-020 (immutable backups in provider B)
manual_workaround: Paper CCP forms and paper pre-shipment review
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Provider A hosting (BP-G03); SYS-G1 sign-in

description: Lot tracing from carcass suppliers through plants, DCs, and stores
process_owner: Group Chief Food Safety and Quality Officer
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: FSIS notification within 24 hours of determining adulterated product entered commerce (9 CFR 418.2); during a recall the MTD drops to 4 hours
source_evidence: EV-080 (Group Chief Food Safety and Quality Officer interview); EV-054 (recall procedure; lot keys)
manual_workaround: Paper lot logs; DC shipment records; store receiving records
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Needs DC shipment data (BP-D02) and store receiving data (BP-R05)

description: Inbound receiving, temperature checks on arrival, FSIS transaction records, and FDA records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Receivers must assess temperature abuse on arrival (21 CFR 1.908(d)); FSIS transaction records (9 CFR 320.1(b)(1))
source_evidence: EV-082 (division food safety manager interview); EV-062 (FSIS and FDA records)
manual_workaround: Paper receiving logs; probe thermometers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Meat Processing shipments to DCs

description: Orders to DCs and direct-store vendors; meat-counter grinding logs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Grinding records for raw ground beef (9 CFR 320.1(b)(4)); shelves empty after 2 to 3 days
source_evidence: EV-083 (retail store operations VP interview); EV-079 (grinding logs)
manual_workaround: Manual orders by phone; paper grinding logs
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Depends on DC shipping (BP-D02) and ERP (BP-G05)

description: The FDA-regulated line at Plant 6 under its food defense plan
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: FDA registered facility; food defense mitigation strategies must keep operating (21 CFR Part 121)
source_evidence: EV-081 (Plant 6 plant manager interview); EV-056 (Plant 6 food defense plan)
manual_workaround: Pause the line; hold raw materials refrigerated
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Shares the CIP manifold and brine system design with the meat lines

description: E-commerce site, mobile app, and fulfillment in stores
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 9% of retail sales; customer complaints and national reviews
source_evidence: EV-083 (digital commerce director interview); EV-003 (online orders about 9% of retail sales)
manual_workaround: Pause online orders; honor scheduled pickups by phone
dependent_third_parties: E-commerce vendor; payment processor; delivery partners
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Provider B hosting; inventory from BP-R05

description: Inventory, order, and temperature visibility for about 60 external brands; EDI
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contract service levels; customers rely on temperature history for their own food safety records; SOC 2 requests (P09)
source_evidence: EV-082 (3PL services director interview); EV-068 (3PL agreements)
manual_workaround: Daily inventory and temperature reports by email from manual logs
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Provider A hosting; cold-chain data from BP-G04

business_process: OT remote access and OT monitoring
description: Remote vendor and engineer access to plant and DC OT; passive OT monitoring
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Vendors can work on site under escort; monitoring loss creates blind spots but does not stop production
source_evidence: EV-080 (Group OT security director interview); EV-023 (SYS-G5 coverage)
manual_workaround: On-site escorted vendor work
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Plants 1, 3, 4, 6; DC-1 and DC-3

business_process: Payroll, HR, financial close, and SEC reporting
description: Payroll for 45,000 employees; close; SEC filings
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Pay dates; SEC filing deadlines; HR data is the group's largest store of employee personal information
source_evidence: EV-080 (Group CFO interview); EV-002 (45,000 employees)
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll; manual journal entries
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All divisions

description: Loyalty accounts, digital coupons, and price files to POS
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers can still buy at shelf price; digital coupons honored later
source_evidence: EV-083 (digital commerce director interview); EV-077 (loyalty platform)
manual_workaround: Shelf price only; honor coupons at the service desk
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Price files feed POS (BP-R01)
